title: Data-Assimilation-Assisted Reinforcement Learning for Power Grid Control under Load Uncertainty
summary: Reliable power grid control requires sequential decisions under transmission constraints, time-varying demand, renewable variability, and imperfect load information. We investigate how load information quality affects control in a customized transmission network simulator inspired by Grid2Op and based on a DC power flow model. The environment includes stochastic spatial loads, temporally correlated renewable-like generation, energy storage, line protection, generator dispatch, and line reconnection.
